sq.q: When does a finite automaton accept a string?
answer: A finite automaton accepts a string if it ends in an accepting (final) state after reading all input symbols.

sq.q: What is the main difference between DFA and NFA?
answer: DFA has exactly one transition for each symbol from a state, while NFA can have multiple or no transitions for a symbol.
